scope_limits.operators: Lifting changes only explicit agreed configurations under fixed branch programs/boundaries/schedule/policy/label. It proves full actual results, not shared-state commutation or arbitrary atomic reassociation.
scope_limits.arithmetic: Exact rational modeled accounting over finite typed identities; no deployed-code correspondence, oracle truth, integer rounding, liveness or market solvency guarantee.
scope_limits.fixtures: Concrete reference instances, actual negative outcomes and synthetic observer pairs are distinct. Generated declarations and runtime fixture definitions are not extra generic semantic theorems.
